notes.title: Announcing Patch 2.02: Friday November 8th!
notes.content:
Launch week was a huge success for Mech Shuffle! There are many new and returning players checking out the latest content. We're working hard on a post-launch update for next Friday. This update features many improvements for new players, as well as quality of life fixes for everyone. There will also be new music tracks, a new reward card, and more!

Featuring New Music
Back by popular demand, the composer for Mech Shuffle has returned! Quinten Lamora is crafting hot new tracks to be included in Friday's patch.

New Reward Card
Lore Events are a type of Event (E) that show up as extra battlefield rewards in Mech Shuffle. These Lore Events push the story forward and give the player more context for the overall state of the invasion on New Bastion. Previously, there was no card reward for finding these events. Now, all Lore Events contain the new Battlefield Vanguard card as a reward:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/bd34a9fd3abd7e5031c6134d3f9f33a7bd0f6747.png

Improved Tooltips
Tooltips now behave as expected: they disappear when you move your mouse, rather than after an arbitrary time span. Tooltips also include token symbols within the text, massively improving readability for many Ability Perks and Tutorial messages:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/79012a18b88ef7204f887837c7b1e7200634a6e0.png

Advanced Tutorial Popups
New players navigate their first tutorial match with ease, coming away with a basic understanding of the Mech Shuffle combat system. However, they are quickly faced with many new advanced tokens and mechanics to figure out. To make the learning process less daunting, we are adding helpful tutorial popups the first time a player encounters each advanced token type:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/4feb08cf5363cbda6695cd5b40eb51e7034742d4.png

And More!
As usual we'll be fitting in as many bug fixes and bits of polish as we can for this patch, so stay tuned for the full patch notes on Friday November 8th!

If you want to support the game, leaving a Steam review helps a ton. If you want to leave feedback or suggestions in the Steam discussion board, I always read them!

notes.title: Announcing: Drop Command
notes.content:
Drop Command?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/66e4aac915a3a5f90d712bea32aa1f36a6d6229c.gif
Drop Command is a mech combat sim with combined arms warfare, epic large battles, and where you can pilot any unit under your command. Drop Command takes place in the same game universe as Mech Shuffle, so you can expect to see a lot of the Mech Shuffle units and lore showing up. 

I have been working on this project since October 2021. Two years later, and it finally has a Steam store page! This is a huge milestone for Drop Command, and I hope you are as excited for it as I am.

Wishlist To Show Support!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/2fc16d95a1192fc5f577522fbf03039e63a84be6.gif
Drop Command is still being developed. With the launch of the Steam page we are officially moving from pre-alpha to alpha status. This means that the core gameplay has been tested and well established. However, there is still a lot of work to be done fleshing out various systems and building content (more units, map sets, weapons, mission types, etc).

If you want to show support, every wishlist makes a huge impact on the games visibility, and would mean a lot to me!

How does this impact Mech Shuffle?

I have been developing Mech Shuffle and Drop Command together, and I will continue to do so. You can still expect more content for Mech Shuffle as I work towards getting it out of Early Access. My plan is to release Mech Shuffle sometime in the coming year (2024), and continue to support it with content updates after that. Once Mech Shuffle leaves Early Access, I will want to take a short break from it to focus on finishing Drop Command.

notes.title: 30% Sale for Patch 1.09!
notes.content:
In celebration of the Indie Cup Canada 2023, we are releasing Patch 1.09 on October 4th, with a 30% sale starting today! 

You can expect a lot of new content, including:

 New Assault Mech: The Goliath
 New Mech Variants: Dodo M, Behemoth A, and Mantis L
 New Token Type: Enhance Capsule
 New Reward Type: Perks
 End of Run Stats

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/47d6e574ca4e6615d57368f166bbc1990acd68f0.pngNew Mech: The Goliath{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/47d6e574ca4e6615d57368f166bbc1990acd68f0.png

The Goliath is an advanced Assault Mech built to be a powerful mobile artillery battery. With this unique starting load out, you will need careful planning and tactical foresight to blast your way to victory:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/c468af2e052f50988910074499cc0ca688a240ca.png

Mech Variants

Mech Variants allow us to add new play styles for existing Mechs. In this patch we are adding three new variants to check out: the Missile focused Dodo M, the Auger Analytic capable Behemoth A, and bristling with light weapon mounts, the Mantis L.

New Rewards and Event Type: Perks

The new Perk rewards can be found by defeating bosses, or through a new Event type. Perks can give your deck small advantages, activated abilities, or they can unlock new win conditions by adding new mechanics like overheat damage

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/0dd7eae59ba490c5c2cd806cf652fe1ce897704a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/e19267b5af92b06caec7f7ff215139c16b8f6dad.png

Perks offer a wide array of new strategies for deck building. With over 50 new perks to find, there is a ton of new strategy and synergy to explore and discover.

New Cards

With so many new Mechs and new Perks to play with, we have also added several new cards to fill gaps in the play space. For example, Heavy Unguided Missiles adds a weak early game missile weapon, which scales to become very powerful in the late game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/08b4c00c72f16ea4e3e0a391e9a0e2ed6728696e.png

New Token Type: Enhance Capsule
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/4e3b4a605d5e4e05565715316633195f972676b1.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/4e3b4a605d5e4e05565715316633195f972676b1.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/4e3b4a605d5e4e05565715316633195f972676b1.png
This versatile token serves a similar role as the Enhance tokens. However, instead of doubling the matching damage and block tokens, the new Enhance Capsule token allows you to double your cooling, heat, and fortify tokens.

End Of Run Stats

We've added a stats screen at the end of a run, so you can see what your journey looked like, and compare with friends.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/c0db4858a72190c2e18bc3a20584fbcd374657cc.png

Balance Changes

In light of the effect that Card Cycling has had on the Mech Shuffle meta, many cards with Card Draw tokens are having their cost reduced by 1. This buff should bring those cards back into use, since they will now be a more viable alternative to cycling cards. Some cards affected by this change include: Safety Override, Pilot Skill: Operations, and Pilot Skill: Running Hot.

And Plenty More!

We have also added new VFX to highlight which token will be doubled when a card is played, we fixed several bugs, buffed System: Missile Guidance to be a more appealing option for missile builds, and more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/e4d9e79e023ac197da10e242a222f9645d26cbf5.png

Give the new build a try on October 4th, and let us know how we're doing by leaving a review!

There are 3 new events, including a special Pilot Event to unlock pilot FALK. We have made several balance changes, including changes to the DODO and BERINGER card packs. There are several VFX and SFX updates, an updated tutorial for new players, and tons more!

notes.title: Mech Shuffle: Major Content Patch Arriving April 7th!
notes.content:
Coming April 7th, we have a major content update for Mech Shuffle! We are adding a new game mode, new control cards, a Card Compendium, and tons more. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/1423bcb980d7d56ca966648db747970fd90661d1.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/cf45538385ea655b1988b89423b8406ef5c92bf0.gif

New Game Mode: Hard Mode

A new single player game mode is being added. Hard Mode introduces permanent battle damage, and the need to carefully balance risk and reward when choosing end of combat upgrades versus repairs. Hard Mode is not meant for new players who are still learning the ins and outs of heat management, card cycling, and deck building. You will unlock the ability to start a hard mode run once you have reached Wave 4 with any Mech. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/dbd65de437f1cc5b78bc65e4b5908491d1d40b4f.png
After that, you can start a new run as usual, and a new "Activate Hard Mode" button will be available before you choose your first encounter. Expect a real challenge, and an achievement for giving Hard Mode a try.

Card Compendium
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/0c4fad97e9240570260dc35dcd4c4a84b324641f.png
Now available next to the settings button, you will find the Card Compendium button. This opens a new screen which will let you browse all of the cards in the game by category, and to view the full upgrade paths for each card. With this knowledge, you can make informed decisions about which cards to add to your deck, which to remove, and which to upgrade all the way!

New Cards

With this content patch we have a bunch of exciting new cards to play with! Cards like E-Pulse Cannon will add more control deck options to the game:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/ecb617f769b98b835328f39c9c0c4a60ede3df94.png
While other cards are adding more defensive deck building options:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/45a29f0a614aeea7de3d2ed596e5e7abfbf06ce2.png

Here are some of the new cards to look forward to:

 Pilot Skill: Sentinel
 Heavy Flamer
 Support: Artillery Barrage
 E-Pulse Cannon
 Shroud Missile
 System: Laser Point Defense
 System: Synaptic Core
 System: Auger Analytic Tracker

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/c9243dba0432f4f61fc1e09b54c806d7345dc030.png

Balance Changes

Several cards are being adjusted. Some are being changed for game balance, some to make cards feel more unique in their intended role, and some to open design space for new cards. The Flamer cards have been adjusted for all of these reasons:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/e7d820e205f9abfda6507884b615c37305bc5db6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/60bd3cc0a39243b95dcb131e160342fbebed02c8.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/c19bd4edba4d598dfa1fddaf461cea17dbc94bb2.png

Card Pack Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/fe4760eed1e32bc66636d0ea930760b9d72053dc.gif
Two card packs are being adjusted. The DODO light mech is replacing one Flamer with the new Heavy Flamer. This will help address some issues the DODO has with dealing early game damage. The reduction in heat cost for Quirk: Jump Jets is meant to improve the defensive capabilities of the DODO during the first wave of a run.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/06922de07caddf6fef2b9019f40c6d46ca0df124.png

The aggressive pilot BERINGER is also being updated, replacing Proficiency: Heat with the new Pilot Skill: Sentinel. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/bc1fd616b4aa8afbcce8610e711e80b4212a3e9d.png
This change is meant to open up more viable strategies involving BERINGER. Previously this pilot was almost exclusively used in combination with the TAURUS, while now she can be used effectively with most missile focused builds, or in a more control oriented deck.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/873b8162808b46f9717446151dc9b6d8b4dc245d.png

And More!

The pilot pack FALK will have a second method of unlock, so that she can be unlocked without playing Ranked Play. There will be several bug fixes, VFX and SFX updates, new achievements, an improved tutorial for first time Mech pilots, and more. 

I have had a lot of fun getting this patch ready, and I am very excited to get it out for you to try. See you all on April 7th!

notes.title: Announcing: 25% off Sale, Ranked Play, and new Pilot Pack!
notes.content:
Coming February 14th, we have a major content update planned for Mech Shuffle! This includes a whole new game mode, and a new pilot pack. Mech Shuffle will be part of the Indie Cup Celebration 2023 sale. This will be the final sale at our Early Access price point, so plan accordingly!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/5034be17ce786077d5eaa46ab86aeff22846107f.png
New Game Mode: Ranked Play
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/40ca5996788ada80bdb38a6e3ac0bcaf267758c1.gif
Until now, if you wanted to play against a human opponent, your only option was local hotseat. With our latest patch, you can now test your skills against online opponents! Entering the Ranked Play mode will earn you an ELO rating, rank you on the leaderboard, and help you to unlock the newest Pilot Pack.

New Pilot Pack: FALK
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/cac75f0d89395b5265442c86c5e28d977f2bd667.png
Meet the newest Mech pilot: FALK! Unlockable by winning 10 ranked matches in the new Ranked Play game mode.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/5b45b5035ab0d92aee121cf83956bb02c3cd0d55.png

FALK takes control of the battlefield with the new card Pilot Skill: Outmaneuver. By strategically removing action points from an opponent, FALK limits their offensive and defensive options. FALK is the only pilot with Pilot Skill: Misdirect in their starting arsenals, allowing her to swing the heat gauges in her favour over time; simultaneously cooling FALKS mech, and forcing the opponent to spend additional heat to keep up. Pilot Skill: Patchwork is a unique defensive card, allowing FALK to fortify her armour and survive over longer engagements.

Indie Cup Celebration 2023 Sale

The lowest price yet for Mech Shuffle, at 25% off our Early Access price. We are proud to be a part of the Indie Cup Celebration Sale this year. The sale will run for 1 week from February 14th to February 22nd. After the sale ends, we will be increasing the price of Mech Shuffle to reflect our progress towards leaving Early Access.

notes.title: New Content, New Features, New Game Mechanics
notes.content:
Patch 1.06 for Mech Shuffle will be releasing this Friday, January 13th! With this patch we are adding plenty of new content, as well as paving the way for updates throughout 2023. Here are some of the things you can expect to see on Friday:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/94ca18b5255650f1777aa8651cdc58deb43853e3.png

 New Game Mechanic: Card Cycling (right click a card to spend an action point and cycle)
 New Token Type: Cycling (playing adds to your cycling side board)
 New Reward Event Type: Pilot Events (upgrade pilot cards, get new ones)
 New Cards (20+)
 New Encounter Events
 External Save Files and Cloud Saves
 Pilot Pack Changes: Sherman and Emrys
 New Music Track by Quinten
 A smarter, more intelligent AI
 Rewards in Mech Bays will now always be different
 Custom game cursor
 Several Bug Fixes

Improved Save System

The improved Save System includes the switch to external save files, as well as the implementation of Steam Cloud Saving. This will let you carry your saved games over from one computer to the next, as long as you are using Steam to launch your game.

Due to the major changes to the save system with this patch, any runs in progress will be lost after the update. So if you want to finish your current run, do it before you install the Friday patch!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/dab08411f5e120890f94a82e74b968d96164cc51.png
New Game Mechanic: Card Cycling

The new Card Cycling mechanic will Increase the decision space for players. You can now choose to spend an action point to discard any card in hand (by right clicking on it). This cycles the card by discarding it and immediately drawing a new card to replace the old one. 

Now you can choose to not play cards: to conserve heat, to force your opponent to play first, or to draw that combo card hiding in your deck. Of course, action points are already a precious commodity, needed to fire your weapons, defend against attacks, sink heat, etc. This means that the choice to cycle comes with its own cost.

Cycling also increases the design space by allowing new gameplay and card designs for the future.  Ordinarily, you can Card Cycle to draw a card. However, there is a new token type being added to the game to take advantage of cycling: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/2f8163fa635bd7c909847b5e91282a807c14782a.png

When you play a token with the cycle symbol, it will enter a side board with all of your cycle effects (rather than going immediately into play). When you later cycle a card, all of the tokens in your side board will enter play. This lets you use actions to stockpile effects for later use. You can build powerful combos this way, or use cycling to counter the more aggressive decks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/ecba9434c2b92f2598b1c7406dceeff3ac24f751.png

Pilot Pack Changes

There will be many new cards added to the game with this patch, most of them making use of the new Card Cycle mechanic. Two Pilot Packs are being updated to use the cycling mechanic. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/c79c8acac09f5f0c646871ddb57b53302d630d08.png

Sherman is losing Pilot Skill: Tactics in favour of Pilot Skill: Synaptic Savant. Since Sherman is unlocked early in Mech Shuffle, this change will give new players a chance to play around with the cycle mechanic as a defensive option.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/5cc8296f8ce11ea3d9e58b53779c41e69143202c.png

Emrys is getting a major overhaul, with three new cards. Emrys will still be the energy weapons specialist, with Pilot Skill: Adaptive Alignment, but now she has the skills to build a powerful side board to enable safe swing turns (Pilot Skill: Foresight) where she quickly dumps excess heat (Pilot Skill: Heat Cycling), and sets up for a powerful laser blast on the following turn.

Event Type: Pilot Events

Previously, it was very difficult to upgrade your Pilot Cards. Now, your pilots can grow along with your mechs through Pilot Events. 

The new Pilot Events add a much needed way to improve your pilot skills. A Pilot Event will give you the ability to upgrade your existing pilot cards, or to add new pilot cards to your deck. The quality of the new cards will depend on your pilot level. Higher level pilots will have a better chance at more upgraded card options.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/95bcb39b1628ff6d176e7d53694a2cae800e62b3.png

Thank You For Playing Mech Shuffle!

Thanks everyone for playing Mech Shuffle, and for all of your feedback and suggestions. Now let's make this game even better for 2023.

notes.title: Introducing Events, Assault Mechs, Mech Bays, and More!
notes.content:
Announcing the biggest mega-patch yet for Mech Shuffle! I have been hard at work adding new content, fixing bugs, and working on accessibility. Here are some of the things you can expect to see on November 25th:

 Updated Sprites for mechs and terrain
 New Assault Class mech
 New match rewards (events, lore, mech labs)
 50 New Cards (now at 150+ cards)
 New Token types (fortify armour)
 Improved accessibility
 And tons more!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/e130794735a284068ba262948b6540c51ecb5a14.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/6b52c6ac74c00abf295c85a3e201d56c1eba9d12.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/71d4234f460c0a71a225ef6d567564870ecce940.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/4a0b15f56d87b7988bebb8af61a701ddc71f2d8d.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/ecd28242a6541afe92708f9586c94997ee311af1.png

New Assault Mech: MANTIS

The MANTIS is an imposing foe to face on the battlefield, and you can unlock it as a new playable mech. Like any Assault Mech, the MANTIS is a bastion of self defence, and a true weapons platform which can make excellent use of any weapon system:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/39ebbc1c0ddd364869c5656fb860bf5fe8f70c46.png

New Match Rewards

Choosing your path through the battlefield is going to be even more impactful than before. Asides from the usual end of match salvage rewards, you will often have the choice between additional rewards:

 A random event (high risk, high reward!) {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/0a95117c5df205bbb79380a2e114c96a7cfa956e.png
 A Battlefield Mech Bay (UPGRADE CARDS!) {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/a0cb75c913e369767fefabc1422d6b24e29ae710.png
 A Mech Manufactory Bay (DUPLICATE CARDS!) {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/25769d198d3ec80c60899ce701cfb457886461f4.png
 A Battlefield Refit Bay (REMOVE CARDS!) {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/ef6315a1eb6ffaf1449d0a920906a0a142ec846e.png


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/f1fc1356cf67dedc7b9ad70632396dab44a9d612.png


New Cards

A large number of new cards are being added to the game, bringing us up to the 150+ cards mark. There are new Pilot Skill cards, new weapons, new system cards, and a lot more to discover. Some new cards are only available through encountering events!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/d8d7edd036dfc8f988cce1a0013a5b2c7ef5f7ad.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/79ea632bb387e19192acda91c82c3ee9780bbd9a.png

New Token: Fortify Armour

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/2b1bfd3ae351b41fd471c14960fa7bd31fb618ee.png Fortify Armour allows you to double the effectiveness of an armour token, so that it can absorb an additional point of damage before being destroyed. Beware though, this is not a repair. You won't be able to fortify an armour point if it has already been destroyed!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/b87c60d703b5535f2b1dc9f9c248b75db408971a.png

Accessibility Improvements

We've increased the font sizes throughout the game, to improve readability and accessibility. As well, Mech Shuffle requires colour matching to play properly, so it was important to add an accessibility option for people with colour vision deficiency. If you find yourself having difficulty distinguishing the different token damage types, give the new palette a try.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/7373fbe043f1544d00beffd008eddf0d57d15a21.png

Mech Shuffle was accepted to join in Indie Cup Canada 2022! With over 100 games showcased by Canadian indie developers, the competition is fierce. The judges will be playing and scoring games until the winners are revealed November 17th. Best of luck to everyone in the competition.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/bd3db99ee552b035215993e362d03f4c4646ea95.png

The competition happens to align nicely with our next planned content patch. Win or lose in the Indie Cup, Mech Shuffle will be getting a big content patch in November. Here are some of the things you can expect to see:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/1c571231164bad8d828b7b4faaaef1c2c689e7f7.png

 - New Mech Sprites (I will miss my "programmer art", but I am very happy with the new look!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/8e05cad0c4a153c84fa50e25d999dd753825dd6a.png

 - Many New Cards (stay tuned for the pre-patch announcement in November)
 - New "Fortify Armour" Token
 - New Reward Events (including ways to remove cards from your deck)

And of course a lot more, I won't spoil too much before the patch is ready. 

We are very honoured to have the opportunity to participate in Indie Cup Canada this year. We have a lot planned for Mech Shuffle in the coming months, and your feedback will help shape what is coming next. Leave us a comment here, or join the Steam Discussion page to let us know what you want to see next.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2075760/Mech_Shuffle/

notes.title: Big Update, New Content!
notes.content:
New content for Mech Shuffle arriving August 29th 2022!

It has been one month since launch day, and I am excited to share the first content patch with you. The patch includes plenty of new stuff, such as:  a new pilot, new cards, new tokens and mechanics, terrain effects, and more. 

We're still in early access, so head on over to the Steam Discussion page for Mech Shuffle and give us your feedback!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/a747545bdbf189acbeaa463629c4fa2c75b1a61f.png

The most immediate change is a large update to the UI and the UX. We have updated the look of the game board, the cards, the tokens, and improved the user interface.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/31be1c996d5e707ea250c996271e2d20730230a4.png

The addition of a new pilot pack will open many new deck building possibilities. BERINGER is a very aggressive pilot, with two weapon proficiencies, and a new card Pilot Skill: Overwhelm to break through enemy defences.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/9dd298bee7f74217973be6473a8279e292702d73.png

We added four new terrain types to encounter, each with a unique battlefield effect. Choosing your next encounter now includes an extra layer of tactical decision making, which evolves as your Mech and Pilot specialize and learn new tricks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/3008b14d0e23725cebdc54f6d633b67fa12d2ff6.png

There are four new cards being added. We already mentioned Pilot Skill: Overwhelm. We also have the powerful Artillery Cannon, which can smash through ballistic blocks with ease. The techy System: Missile Guidance, to ensure your missiles hit their target. And finally, the very powerful defensive card System: ECM.

This is the first content update since launch, but it certainly won't be the last! We have a lot planned for Mech Shuffle in the future, and your feedback will help shape what is coming next. Leave us a comment here, or join the Steam Discussion page to let us know what you want to see next.

###########################################################

VERSION 1.04 Patch Notes
* UI and UX Updated
* Improved Tutorial
* New Pilot: BERINGER
* New Cards: 
  -- Pilot Skill: Overwhelm
  -- Artillery Cannon
  -- System: Missile Guidance
  -- System: ECM
* New Token: Break Block
* Terrains Effects Added
  -- Temperate Grassland (effect: none)
  -- Scorching Desert (effect: extra heat token)
  -- Rocky Highlands (effect: extra action point)
  -- Glacial Ravine (effect: extra cooling token)
  -- Mired Marsh (effect: lose action point)
* Card Changes:
  -- Quirk: Melee Flamers, proficiency token is now delayed
* Token Changes: 
  -- Heat Damage/Block has been renamed Fire Damage/Block
  -- Heat Damage/Block changed token color from red to orange
* Bug Fixes:
  -- Fixed issue where loading a run could change enemy loadout

notes.title: Save/Load, Card Changes, More Music, Release on July 29th
notes.content:
Are you ready for the launch of Mech Shuffle on July 29th 2022?

This is the final patch before launch, and we have added some important features such as the ability to save/load a run. This means that you will be able to quit a run at any time, and return to it later. Several cards were also updated to better balance the overall game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/4749fd29be3b6101329ec773656a98dc44765132.png

The cost reduction for Targeting Computer (Level 1) will help the card to fill the important role of delaying actions, without penalizing the player with undue extra heat.
 
Changing the Level 2 Machine Gun will provide incentive to chain them over multiple rounds rather than all at once. This will reduce the burst damage output of this low cost weapon.

The upgrade to Unguided Missiles (Level 2) felt weak at 4 heat when compared to other similar options, and should be a more viable upgrade option at 3 heat.

Several new music tracks have been added, and an audio glitch was fixed. The pilot pack SHERMAN was updated, replacing the card Running Hot with Vent Heat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/a33e96b088b3a3a152915adbf5545fe2f4b321b0.png

This is the last update before launch, I hope our next patch will include lots of new content! I'll see you all on launch day.

###########################################################

VERSION 1.03 Patch Notes
- implemented save states (you may quit a run at any time, and return to it later!)
- new music tracks added (Tracks by Quinten)
- fixed audio clipping bug
- PACK CHANGES:
    - SHERMAN: removed Running Hot, added Vent Heat
- CARD CHANGES:
    - Machine Gun (Level 2): proficiency token is now delayed
    - Targeting Computer (Level 1): now cost 0 heat instead 1
    - Unguided Missiles (Level 2): now cost 3 heat instead of 4

notes.title: New Features, New Content, Getting Ready For Release!
notes.content:
It has been an exciting couple of weeks, getting ready for Mech Shuffle to launch on July 29th 2022!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/e1718fec305cdc6d1e45a3320111762ddb6762ae.png

In this penultimate patch before launch, we have added some important features and content. As well as balancing the card drop rates. When choosing your PILOT and your MECH card packs, you can now see a full preview of the cards in the pack (informed decision making!). 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/f116065543fccec0d92bc83eaff5a18e691e0bb0.png

It will now be more obvious when a mech is close to overheating, with heat warnings visibly flashing and and audibly blaring.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627825/53a46262f480d460ff6e0e009c4f24becf28f981.png

The settings menu saw two new additions: a "Windowed Mode" toggle for those who like to multitask, and separate volume sliders for Music and Sound Effects. 

We will have one more major update before July 29th, so stay tuned for updates! I'll see you all on launch day.


###########################################################

VERSION 1.02 Patch Notes
- PILOT and MECH Card Packs now display cards on hover
- UPGRADE cards show previous card level on hover (during rewards selection)
- discard piles now display cards on hover
- added an "Overheat Warning": VFX and SFX at 7+ heat
- when playing two player hotseat: player turns are now visually announced
- card rarity drop rate changed, base weights: Common 25, Rare 10 + mod, Epic 5 + (mod / 2), Legendary 1 + (mod / 3)
- settings menu update: windowed mode toggle added, separate volume sliders for SFX and music 
- minor bug fixes
